verdict.rationale: No option clearly dominates across the stated criteria. A offers the strongest rating and shortest drive but is materially pricier after the resort fee and has paid parking. B is the least expensive and nearly as close, but has a lower rating, smaller desk, and limited parking. C is a balanced work-and-location option with included parking, but is neither cheapest, closest, nor highest rated. D provides a suite workspace, breakfast, and free parking at a lower rate than C or A, but has a substantially longer commute. Choosing among these tradeoffs requires unstated priorities about budget, lodging quality, workspace, breakfast, and commute tolerance.
